email_subject: Application - Customer Success Manager at Great Place To Work®
email_body:
Dear Kirby,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager role at Great Place To Work®. Your mission of helping organisations build high-trust, high-performance cultures resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my mix of client-facing digital experience and data-driven problem-solving to your team.

In my current roles, I manage client websites and SEO projects end to end: onboarding, advising on platform adoption, running audits, and translating data into clear, actionable recommendations. I'm comfortable working primarily online, coordinating multiple projects at once, and explaining technical findings in plain language. I'm data-savvy with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, and I have a commercial eye for spotting opportunities to add value.

I'm fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and improving my Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your clients' success.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Kirby,

I'm applying for the Customer Success Manager position at Great Place To Work®. The chance to help organisations create workplaces where employees trust their leaders, take pride in their work, and enjoy their colleagues feels like a natural extension of what I already do: helping clients get real value from digital platforms.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage client relationships and projects from onboarding through ongoing support. I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, and I regularly advise on how to use tools like WordPress, Elementor, and Rank Math more effectively. I run technical audits, interpret data from Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, and translate those findings into clear recommendations clients can act on. I also coordinate multiple projects at once, from building a site for a pharmacists' association with around 600 member profiles to maintaining Shopify stores and publishing blog content.

What draws me to this role is the combination of client success and data-informed advice. I enjoy listening to what clients need, framing the value of a platform in terms of their goals, and delivering insights that help them improve. I'm comfortable working primarily through online interactions, and I'm meticulous about timelines and deliverables. I'm fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and improving my Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+).

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience with client support, data analysis, and digital platforms could contribute to the Great Place To Work® team. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:
• Client-facing digital project management: onboarding, advising, and supporting clients on WordPress, Shopify, and SEO initiatives, with a focus on platform adoption and satisfaction.
• Data-savvy analysis and reporting: using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to clients.
• Strong organisational skills: managing multiple simultaneous projects, from building a 600-profile association site to maintaining e-commerce catalogues and content calendars.
• Commercial mindset: identifying opportunities to add value and improve client outcomes through customised digital solutions and ongoing support.
• Multilingual communication: fluent English, native Turkish, and improving Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), with experience explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
